text:
carla: Quick note — noticed a 404 when clicking the 'prefix caching' TOC link in the runtime guide. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/serving#prefix-caching :eyes:

sam: Good catch. I can take this. Is it in the hosted docs or a KB runbook?

carla: Hosted docs (repo docs.redwood.ai). Repro steps: open /runtime/serving then click the 'prefix caching' anchor under 'Caching & batching'. Getting 404.

alex: I can repro. Looks like the header id was renamed. Grep shows `kv-prefix-caching` in the file now.

sam: I'll open a tiny PR to update the link to `#kv-prefix-caching` or add an inline alias anchor.

maria: Please add me as a reviewer. Also add a CHANGES.md note so the external redirect isn't surprising to integrators.

sam: PR created: https://git.internal.redwood/Docs/pull/3421 — one-line sed change. CI passed.

sam: command I used locally:
``
git checkout -b fix/doc-anchor-3421
sed -i 's/#prefix-caching/#kv-prefix-caching/g' docs/runtime/serving.md
git commit -am "docs: fix anchor for prefix caching link"
git push && open PR
```

docs-bot: FYI link-checker scan flagged this as anchor-broken earlier today (ticket DOCS-212).

alex: Merging now. I'll monitor the staging preview; if the anchor still 404s we'll add a redirect rule in the site config.

carla: Awesome — thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: LGTM once staging renders. If anything else pops up ping me in this thread.

carla: will do. Leaving a note in the weekly docs sweep board that we still need to audit anchors under /runtime.
